definitions.explanation: A farm or plantation where apples are grown — an orchard of apple trees. Many such places in Japan (especially in Aomori, Nagano, and other apple-producing regions) are also open to visitors for seasonal apple picking.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}にりんご{園|えん}を{訪|おとず}れた。
examples.english: I visited an apple orchard in autumn.

examples.japanese: りんご{園|えん}でりんご{狩|が}りを{楽|たの}しんだ。
examples.english: We enjoyed apple picking at the apple orchard.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{長年|ながねん}、{青森|あおもり}で{小|ちい}さなりんご{園|えん}を{営|いとな}んでいた。
examples.english: My grandfather ran a small apple orchard in Aomori for many years.

examples.japanese: {観光客|かんこうきゃく}の{受|う}け{入|い}れを{始|はじ}めてから、このりんご{園|えん}は{地域|ちいき}の{人気|にんき}スポットになった。
examples.english: After it began accepting visitors, this apple orchard became a popular local attraction.

notes:
Composed of りんご (apple) and {園|えん} (garden, plantation, farm). The kanji {園|えん} is a common suffix meaning 'cultivated land' or 'grounds,' found in many similar compounds.

USAGE:
This is the standard word for an apple orchard. It is often seen on signage, tourism websites, and farm names. Many {りんご園|りんごえん} in Japan offer seasonal {りんご{狩|が}り} (apple picking) from roughly September through November. The word covers both commercial farms and smaller family operations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- りんご{園|えん}を{営|いとな}む: to run an apple orchard
- りんご{園|えん}で{働|はたら}く: to work at an apple orchard
- りんご{園|えん}でりんご{狩|が}り: apple picking at an orchard
- {観光|かんこう}りんご{園|えん}: a tourist-friendly apple orchard

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {果樹園|かじゅえん}: orchard — the general term for any fruit-tree orchard
- ぶどう{園|えん}: vineyard; grape orchard — a closely parallel word for grapes
- みかん{園|えん}: mandarin-orange orchard — parallel for citrus
- りんご{農家|のうか}: apple farmer / apple-farming household — refers to the grower rather than the land
